$fixture: revision 5, from Bruno's executed arithmetic: sequential, restart, boundary and rollover controls for the daily orientation charge.
$whyThisExists: Revision 3 summed orientationTokens over LIVE spawns. Seven sequential peers at 90,308 spend 632,156 against a 600,000 cap while every live total read at admission is 0, and maxPerHour 6 spread over two hours catches none of them. Live occupancy is not a charge ledger.

sequential.$case: seven peers admitted one at a time, each exiting before the next is admitted, spread over two hours
redIf: the seventh is admitted because live occupancy is 0
any admission check reads live occupancy instead of the ledger
a charge disappears when its child exits

restart.$case: the seat service restarts between admissions six and seven
restart.expected: the seventh still refuses; the ledger is replayed from disk, never reconstructed from live rows
restart.redIf: the reserved total resets to 0 or to the live-row sum after restart

boundary.$case: a cap landing exactly on the reserved total
boundary.expected: an admission whose reservation reaches exactly the cap is admitted; the next is refused

rollover.$case: the UTC day rolls over between admissions
rollover.expected: the new window starts empty, migrates no charge, and carries its own window id on every entry; the old window is retained 35 days
rollover.redIf: a charge migrates into the new window, or the old window is deleted early

retry.$case: the producer retries under the same operationId
retry.expected: the existing reservation is found; one charge, one child

redIf: a double charge or a second child from a retry
a refund on anything but a named pre-launch failure

$scope: this tests the policy's declared estimate accounting. It claims no measured model-token cost.
